who: Buyers, and sellers and company admins when they buy
overview: A buyer posts what the company needs and decides among the answers. Use an **enquiry** when you want prices quickly from matching suppliers, and an **RFQ** when you need formal bids against criteria.
can: Post an enquiry or an RFQ for your company.
Read replies and bids, message suppliers, shortlist and choose.
Edit, close or cancel a requirement, and post a similar one.

rules: Suppliers see your contact details only after they respond, and only on plans that include them.
An RFQ adds line items, criteria for suppliers to meet, and dates for each stage.

after: The supplier you chose is told, and so are the others. Carry on with the supplier in **Messages**.

website: Your company's own page and details.
